name: clinical-trial-design
description: MCP server for clinical trial design. Computes sample size, power, group-sequential boundaries, NPH (MaxCombo / RMST / milestone), Monte Carlo verification, and markdown reporting via the gsDesign / gsDesign2 R packages. Covers Phase 2 and Phase 3 confirmatory designs.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.stage-r: rm -rf r && mkdir -p r && cp -r ../r-package/ClinicalTrialDesign/R ../r-package/ClinicalTrialDesign/inst ../r-package/ClinicalTrialDesign/NAMESPACE ../r-package/ClinicalTrialDesign/DESCRIPTION r/
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run stage-r
